screens.name: Global · Government masthead & citizen shell

findings.element: Accessibility toolbar missing from the government masthead
findings.figma: The gov masthead carries the full inline accessibility toolset (A−/A/A+, contrast) plus an accessibility icon that opens the UX4G Accessibility Widget — a GIGW/UX4G-mandated control set present on every page.
findings.live: On every screen (citizen + admin) the inline toolset is reduced to a single glyph and the UX4G widget is a detached floating FAB, so the mandated accessibility controls are absent from the masthead.
findings.fix: Restore the inline A−/A/A+ + contrast controls in the gov-bar on every page and trigger the UX4G widget from the bar's accessibility icon (not a floating FAB). Applies to every screen (citizen + admin).
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Co-branding logos + Digital India wordmark mis-render (font-loading)
findings.figma: Co-branding lockups (National Emblem, Digital India, SAMAVESH) render crisply from correct hi-res assets in the correct typeface.
findings.live: The Digital India logo renders incorrectly and its wordmark falls back to a serif face (webfont not loading); the SAMAVESH login-hero lockup is blurry. Repeats on every masthead.
findings.fix: Use correct hi-res/SVG co-branding assets and fix the wordmark font-loading fallback. Applies to the masthead on every screen and the login hero.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Icon system
findings.figma: All icons come from one Material Symbols family at a consistent size/style; no emoji.
findings.live: Icons mix families/sizes/styles and emoji appear in places (e.g. the citizen track result). Repeats across screens.
findings.fix: Standardise all icons to one Material Symbols family + consistent size/style and replace emoji with Material icons. Applies to every screen.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Emblem–text divider & baseline alignment
findings.figma: The updated design shows the National Emblem beside the ministry text, baseline-aligned, with no divider.
findings.live: The build shows a divider between the emblem and text and the emblem isn't baseline-aligned. Repeats on every masthead.
findings.fix: Remove the emblem–text divider and align the emblem to the text baseline. Applies to every masthead.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

screens.note: Scope: Global — these elements repeat across the portal (citizen + admin); fix once in the design system. The board shows a representative frame (Citizen — Home) — open it via 'Figma frame ↗'; each marker's number matches its NHA-GLOBAL id.

screens.name: Global · Admin dashboards & cards

findings.element: KPI cards: figures above the type scale, alert accents lost
findings.figma: KPI numerals sit on the display scale (tops at 28/32), KPI card label text matches the design, and status/danger KPI cards keep their accent styling.
findings.live: KPI numerals render 48–56px, KPI card text styles differ, and alert cards (e.g. SLA Breaches / SLA Compliance) lose their danger/status accent. Repeats on every dashboard.
findings.fix: Bring KPI figures onto the display scale, match KPI card text styles, and restore the status accent on alert KPI cards. Applies to every dashboard.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Chart palette off the status tokens
findings.figma: Data-viz uses the DS status tokens (Info / Warning / Success / Danger) with the brand navy for emphasis.
findings.live: Charts use ad-hoc hues (e.g. #a66a26 / #3730a3 / #b7131a) instead of the status tokens, and donut segments lack separating gaps. Repeats on every dashboard/analytics screen.
findings.fix: Re-map chart series to the status/brand tokens and add gaps between donut segments. Applies to every dashboard/analytics screen.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Sidebar: no fill, thin divider, consistent icons, count badges
findings.figma: The sidebar sits on the surface with only a 1px divider; nav icons share one stroke width + neutral colour with a filled primary-colour icon for the active item; nav items carry trailing count badges; the collapse control reflects the sidebar state.
findings.live: The sidebar has a background fill and no divider; icon stroke/colour vary and the active item isn't a filled primary icon; count badges are missing; the collapse button doesn't reflect state. Repeats on every screen with the sidebar.
findings.fix: Remove the sidebar fill and add a 1px divider; normalise icon stroke + neutral colour with a filled primary active icon; add the count-badge component; bind the collapse button to sidebar state. Applies to every screen with the sidebar.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Section / KPI cards
findings.figma: Section and KPI cards share a consistent header text style, uniform heights within a row (width may flex), a divider between a chart and its legend, and charts that fit within the card.
findings.live: Card header styles differ, row card heights aren't uniform, chart↔legend dividers are missing, and some charts overflow their card. Repeats on every card-based screen.
findings.fix: Standardise card header text, keep uniform card heights per row (flex width), add a chart↔legend divider, and fit charts within the card (horizontal scroll if very wide). Applies to every card-based screen.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Text off the neutral tokens (headings + muted)
findings.figma: Dark text uses Text/Primary #003366 / Text/Dark #1f2937; muted/secondary text uses Text/Hint #374151.
findings.live: Headings render near-black slate (#0f172a / #111827) and muted labels render gray-500/400 (#6b7280 / #9ca3af), flattening the colour hierarchy on every admin screen.
findings.fix: Map headings and muted/secondary text to the neutral text tokens. Applies to every admin screen (shown here on the Grievance-Monitoring list).
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Page-header style

findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Data tables (header, cells, sticky action, hover)
findings.figma: Table header fill + cell text weight/colour follow the list style; role text is Title Case; on wide tables the Action column stays pinned; row hover uses primary/50.
findings.live: Cell text weight/colour differ, role text is lowercase, the Action column isn't sticky on horizontal scroll, and row hover uses a neutral tint. Repeats on every list/table view.
findings.fix: Match table header + cell typography, render roles in Title Case, make the Action column sticky on horizontal scroll, and use primary/50 for row hover. Applies to every list/table view.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Status chips / badges

findings.live: Status/SLA pills don't use the semantic tokens and sometimes appear outside the Status column. Repeats on every list/case view.
findings.fix: Use the DS semantic colours for status/SLA pills and keep them in the Status column. Applies to every list/case view.
findings.subO: Scope: Global — repeats across the portal

findings.element: Pagination
findings.figma: Lists use numbered pages + a rows-per-page selector.
findings.live: Lists use Prev / Next + 'Page X of N' only. Repeats on every list view.
findings.fix: Adopt numbered pagination + a rows-per-page selector across list views (paginate tables beyond ~10–15 rows; hide it for a single page). Applies to every list view.
